sys_variable_set.title: Request a DDI-backed subnet
sys_variable_set.description: Front-door variable set; each variable maps to one Azure module tfvar (see map_to). The contract test keeps this ⊇ the module's required variables.

item_option_new.name: target_platform
item_option_new.help_text: Selects the module + validation scripts; this variable set is the Azure instance.

item_option_new.name: location
item_option_new.help_text: Commercial (.com) Azure region. Pick-list of approved regions; no default.

item_option_new.name: hub_resource_group_name
item_option_new.help_text: Stage-1 (ALZ) output — reference lookup, not free-typed.

item_option_new.name: hub_vnet_id
item_option_new.help_text: Stage-1 output; full VNet resource ID. Pre-populated reference.

item_option_new.name: ddi_subnet_address_prefix
item_option_new.help_text: Must fit the hub, no overlap. Pre-flight + gate conflict-check it.

item_option_new.name: vnios_vm_sku
item_option_new.help_text: Region/NIOS-version dependent; pick-list of approved SKUs.

item_option_new.name: vnios_image
item_option_new.help_text: publisher/offer/sku/version object; pick-list, do not hard-code a version.

item_option_new.name: key_vault_id
item_option_new.help_text: Existing Key Vault holding module secrets. A REFERENCE only — no secret is entered on the form.

item_option_new.name: dns_client_cidrs
item_option_new.help_text: Spoke/on-prem ranges permitted to query DNS.

item_option_new.name: environment
item_option_new.help_text: dev|test|prod — drives tags/sizing and the approval tier.

item_option_new.name: acknowledge_saas_boundary
item_option_new.help_text: Required true only for universal_ddi; drives an extra approval.

item_option_new.name: host_fqdn
item_option_new.help_text: Registered as the A + PTR for the allocated host IP. Consumed by the Flow, not a module tfvar.

item_option_new.name: business_justification
item_option_new.help_text: Read first by the approver. Flow/record field, not a module tfvar.
